lines.text: …I was walking home from the convenience store. I saw him under the bridge. That’s all. Can I go home now?

…That can't be. He was… he was already dead when I found him at midnight. …No. Wait. I heard something earlier. Around ten-fifty, from under the bridge — a tiny bell, ringing, high-pitched. And then someone walked away along the riverbank with a dark umbrella. I couldn't see their face. I hid in a bus shelter… I was too scared to go down until midnight.

Seiran… that's my school. But I'm in 2-A, not 2-B — I don't know that page at all. …Detective, please. There's something I have to tell you. I knew Ishida-sensei. He tutored me in maths, secretly, because Seiran forbids outside lessons. Last night he texted me at 21:40: 'Sorry, Yuki. Cancel tonight. Someone from the old days wants to talk.' …It felt wrong, so I went toward his house. That's why I was on the bridge. Here — look, it's on my phone.
